user_query: trass gmail and stories with terms international mgm ca uk au within last 2 months AND all the trass stories with the epic of 2025-08 or 2025 holiday launch

intent.goal: Find Trass Gmail messages and stories containing international/regional terms and all Trass stories linked to 2025-08 epic or holiday launch epic

generated_query:
SELECT DISTINCT
    u.page_id,
    u.workspace,
    u.database_name,
    u.title,
    u.created_time,
    COALESCE(g.subject, '') as subject,
    COALESCE(g.sender_name, '') as sender_name,
    COALESCE(g.message_content, '') as message_content
FROM unified_content u
LEFT JOIN gmail_content g ON u.page_id = g.page_id
WHERE u.workspace IN ('trass')
AND u.database_name IN ('gmail', 'stories')
AND u.created_time >= datetime('now', '-2 months')
AND (
    -- Gmail content search
    (u.database_name = 'gmail' AND (
        g.subject LIKE '%international%' OR g.message_content LIKE '%international%'
        OR g.subject LIKE '%mgm%' OR g.message_content LIKE '%mgm%'
        OR g.subject LIKE '%ca%' OR g.message_content LIKE '%ca%'
        OR g.subject LIKE '%uk%' OR g.message_content LIKE '%uk%'
        OR g.subject LIKE '%au%' OR g.message_content LIKE '%au%'
    ))
    OR
    -- Stories content search (including epics)
    (u.database_name = 'stories' AND (
        u.title LIKE '%international%'
        OR u.title LIKE '%mgm%'
        OR u.title LIKE '%ca%'
        OR u.title LIKE '%uk%'
        OR u.title LIKE '%au%'
        OR u.title LIKE '%2025-08%'
        OR u.title LIKE '%holiday launch%'
    ))
)
ORDER BY u.created_time DESC
LIMIT 1200;

- Legal business name and addresses
